v.rationale: impl-2 is the cleanest: it splits work properly between the form request and the pricing class, builds the fixed split with collections and guards against dividing by zero, and has the broadest tests. Its one weakness is that it assumes stored codes are uppercase. impl-3 has nearly the same design but crashes with a 500 on zero-priced eligible lines and shows a broken message for empty carts. impl-1 adds atomic claiming of uses, which is well built but beyond the task, and that extra behaviour causes a real bug: re-applying a code the cart already holds at max_uses returns 422. It also has the same broken empty-cart message, so it ranks last.
